insight.transfer_loss: Sending {amount} a month loses about **{loss}** to fees and rates, **{loss_year}** a year. Each percentage point shaved off the transfer route saves {per_point} a month.
insight.fx_risk: {code} risk: if it strengthens 10% ({strong} per {base}), the {code} side costs {at_strong} (**+{delta}**/month); if it weakens 10% ({weak}), it drops to {at_weak}.
insight.crypto_income.short: **{pct}%** of recurring income ({total} a month) arrives in {codes}. If crypto falls 30%, that is **{drop}** a month less, and {month} would end **{short} short**. Consider converting part of it as it arrives.
insight.crypto_income.ok: **{pct}%** of recurring income ({total} a month) arrives in {codes}. If crypto falls 30%, that is **{drop}** a month less; {month} would still end {left} ahead.
insight.cash_out_loss: Converting your {code} income ({amount} a month) loses about **{loss}** a month to exchange fees and spread, {loss_year} a year.
insight.first_month.left: {month} leaves **{left}** after spending and minimum debt payments: about {per_day} a day of slack.
insight.first_month.thin: {month} leaves **{left}** after spending and minimum debt payments: about {per_day} a day of slack. That's thin: one surprise bill wipes it out.
insight.biggest_item: Biggest recurring item: **{name}** at {amount} a month ({pct}% of income).
insight.debt.min_short: {name}: the minimum payment ({min}) doesn't cover the interest ({interest} a month). Without extra payments the balance grows.
insight.debt.min_split: {name}: of the {min} minimum, **{interest}** is interest this month; only {principal} reduces the balance.

insight.debt.paid_off.one: {name} is paid off in **{month}** and costs {interest} ({interest_base}) in interest over {count} month.
insight.debt.paid_off.other: {name} is paid off in **{month}** and costs {interest} ({interest_base}) in interest over {count} months.

insight.debt.not_paid.one: {name} is **not paid off** in this window and costs {interest} ({interest_base}) in interest over {count} month.
insight.debt.not_paid.other: {name} is **not paid off** in this window and costs {interest} ({interest_base}) in interest over {count} months.

insight.debt_payoff.full: {name} is paid off in full in **{month}**: {amount} from {from}, interest up to then included.
insight.debt_payoff.partial: {name}: {from} only holds {held} in {month}, so it pays off {paid} and **{rest} stays owed**, with its minimum payment.
insight.debt_payoff.none: {name}: {from} holds nothing in {month}, so the payoff can't happen and **{rest} stays owed**, with its minimum payment.

insight.goal.missed.one: {name} doesn't reach {target} within {count} month. Getting there needs about **{needed}** a month into it.
insight.goal.missed.other: {name} doesn't reach {target} within {count} months. Getting there needs about **{needed}** a month into it.

insight.shortfall.short: **{month} is {amount} short.** Nothing is taken from your savings automatically.
insight.shortfall.sinking_pot: {name} ({amount} there), which delays what it's saved for
insight.shortfall.no_pots: No savings pot holds money then.
insight.shortfall.owed: If you don't, it's owed on your current account and repaid from the next surplus, which usually costs interest or fees.
insight.overdraft_end: By {month} you still owe **{amount}** on your current account. Something has to give before then.
insight.pot_cost_cut: {name}: {pot} only holds {held} in {month}, so the other {rest} comes out of that month's budget.
insight.withdrawal_cut: {name}: {pot} only holds {held} in {month}, not the {planned} planned.
insight.emergency_fund: There's no emergency fund. A common rule of thumb is three to six months of spending, about {low} to {high} here. You could add a pot of the emergency kind.
change.baseline: as it was before history was kept

issue.id_format: id "{id}" must be lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'
issue.base_crypto: {code} is a cryptocurrency; plan in a fiat currency and add {code} under currencies
issue.strategy: must be avalanche, snowball or listed
issue.is_base: {code} is the base currency; it needs no rate
issue.cash_out_range: must be at least 0 and below 100
issue.no_rate: currency "{code}" has no rate; add it to currencies
issue.scenario_ops: a scenario needs at least one op
issue.schedule: needs start >= 0, every >= 0 and end >= start
issue.no_pots: add at least one savings pot: money left over each month goes there
